sourceTypeExtension.codeRule: provider id + '/' + exact source token; the atomic Withings blood-pressure output uses withings/getmeas:9+10
sourceTypeExtension.rule: Every admitted output makes the exact catalog dispatch token recoverable without reversing its source-record digest.

rawPayloadAdmission.failureRule: The producer fails closed before emission unless the caller supplies exactly one assertion.

statusDefinitions.supported: Version 0.3.0 defines an exact conversion to every shared profile listed for the source element.
statusDefinitions.mapped-standard: Version 0.3.0 admits only the listed source-neutral Sensor recording contract and does not assert a scalar clinical result.
statusDefinitions.platform-exclusive: Version 0.3.0 defines the listed provider-scoped structured profile because no exact shared profile exists.
statusDefinitions.unmodeled: The source element is inventoried, but no shared or provider-scoped profile models it in version 0.3.0 and no output is admitted.
statusDefinitions.deferred: A plausible shared mapping is known, but the source evidence, time semantics, or result shape is insufficient for a conformant version 0.3.0 output.
statusDefinitions.intentionally-unsupported: Version 0.3.0 deliberately refuses a normalized conversion because doing so would be misleading or diagnostic-adjacent.

sourceEvidence.scope: Exact provider data-type tokens and consumed fields frozen in providers[].sourceTypes; conversion operates only on already-obtained payloads and defines no provider fetching.
sourceEvidence.tokenBinding: Each providers[].sourceTypes[].token and elements[].path is part of the exact v0.3.0 consumed source surface.

identity.canonicalization: RFC 8785/JCS serialization of arrays and Unicode scalar-value strings; UTF-8; non-ASCII unescaped; short JSON escapes for quote, reverse solidus, backspace, tab, line feed, form feed, and carriage return; other U+0000 through U+001F as lowercase \u00xx; invalid Unicode surrogates rejected; each source-record Identifier pair serializes as the canonical two-string array [system,value], pairs sort by unsigned lexicographic UTF-8 byte order of those serializations, and duplicate pairs are rejected
identity.digest: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 preimage, lowercase hexadecimal, prefixed with v1:

providerAccountIdentifier.requirement: A complete deployment-scoped pseudonymous Identifier pair. It must be stable for the provider-account scope needed for deduplication.
providerAccountIdentifier.exception: A raw vendor account value may be used only when an explicit deployment privacy policy authorizes that disclosure; this package grants no such authorization.
providerAccountIdentifier.emission: Digest input only; the pair is not copied to the emitted clinical resource.

sourceNativeId.requirement: The exact stable native record or group key supplied by the already-obtained provider payload.
sourceNativeId.emission: Digest input only for FHIR metadata: the raw value must not appear in Resource.id, Identifier.value, extensions, attachment URL/title, or Provenance text. Opaque caller-supplied attachment bytes are not semantically inspected and require separate deployment authorization and minimization.

derivedDigest.meaning: A deterministic business identity for deduplication and reference resolution.
derivedDigest.rule: It is not an access token, credential, proof of authorization, or permission to fetch provider data.

outputDiscriminatorRule.ordinarySupportedMeasurement: the exact measurementId string from the supported element mapping
outputDiscriminatorRule.groupedMapping: the exact outputDiscriminator declared on that groupedMappings row

preimage: sortedSourceRecordIdentifiers flattened as system,value per pair in sorted pair order
sortedSourceRecordIdentifiers flattened as system,value per pair in sorted pair order

identity.resourceIdPolicy: Resource.id is optional and repository-assigned; no provider-native key or digest is copied into Resource.id.
identity.positiveEventSequence: A durable positive event sequence written as a non-zero ASCII digit followed by zero or more ASCII digits; no sign, no leading zero, no other characters. A byte-identical retry reuses the sequence; changed content allocates a higher value.
identity.singleConversionRule: A conversion Provenance has exactly one source-record pair. When a Bundle carries exactly one conversion event, the exchange event is that conversion's emission and reuses its sequence, so the exchange identifier value equals the conversion identifier value byte for byte and only the NamingSystem distinguishes them.

Although two providers report it, each value is the output of an undisclosed proprietary algorithm over different inputs (Withings pulse-wave velocity versus Oura PPG features), so the numbers are not comparable and no shared physiological definition exists; normalizing them under one code would fabricate clinical comparability, and the diagnostic-adjacent 'age' framing makes a shared measurement unsafe. Both provider catalog rows already record this refusal.
